name: Battle Plan
description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

name: Swift Hunter
description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

name: •At All Costs
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Shield Guard for one round. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack during your opponent’s turn while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard directly hit instead. It is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

name: •Press the Advantage
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Swift Hunter for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

name: •Combat Coordination
description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, during its activation this turn, it can reroll one attack or damage roll, then Combat Coordination expires.

name: Sergeant Hulder Craghorn
featDescription: You may choose a friendly Trapdoor marker within 7" of Craghorn. A friendly Faction model/unit with the Tunnel Ambush rule that is not in play immediately ambushes to the chosen marker.  Choose up to 3 friendly Faction models/units that ambushed this turn. They gain +2 to damage rolls. Break Out! lasts one turn.

name: Boundless Charge
description: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.

name: Carnage
description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 to melee attack rolls against enemy models in the spellcaster’s control range. Carnage lasts for one turn.

name: Countermeasure
description: While within 5" of target friendly Faction model/unit, enemy models cannot make ranged attacks.

name: Tactical Supremacy
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Attuned Spirit
description: Once per activation, this model can cast the animus of a warbeast in its battlegroup without spending fury.

name: Earthworks
description: After deployment but before the first turn, place three Trapdoor markers within 24" of the rear edge of your Deployment Zone and not with 5" of each other.

name: Tunnel Network
description: All models within 2" of friendly Trapdoor markers are considered to be in Craghorn's control range.

name: Not My First Rodeo
description: When a friendly Faction model/unit goes into the tunnels, Craghorn’s upkeep spells on it do not expire. Craghorn must still spend fury to upkeep spells on models in the tunnels as if they were on the table.

name: Volume Fire
description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

name: Heal [d3] (★ Action)
description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

name: Condition (★Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

name: Needle
description: Instead of suffering a damage roll, a living model hit by this weapon automatically suffers 1 damage point. This weapon cannot damage non-living models.

name: Anesthesia
description: A living model damaged by an attack with this weapon becomes stationary for one round.

name: Reinforced
description: This model always has cover.

name: Volley Fire
description: This weapon’s attack rolls against warrior models are boosted.

name: Magic Ability
description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

name: •Black Waters (★Action)
description: While within 3" of this model, models treat open terrain as shallow water and gain Resistance Fire. Black Waters lasts for one round.

name: •Hex Bolt (★Attack)
description: Hex Bolt is a RNG 6, POW 13 arcane attack. Models hit cannot make special actions, special attacks, or power attacks for one round.

name: Mage Static
description: Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of this model suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.

name: •Sigil of Power (★ Action)
description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

name: Warchief Bagadibawm
featDescription: Friendly Faction models in Bagadibawm’s control area gain +2 SPD and Ghostly for one round. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

name: Brand of Fire
description: Brand of Fire causes fire damage. On a hit, the target model and the d3 nearest enemy models within 3" of it suffer the Fire continuous effect.

name: Fire Step
description: Enemy models currently within 2" of the spellcaster suffer a POW 13 fire damage roll . After the damage is resolved, place the spellcaster completely within 2" of its current location. Fire Step can be cast only once per activation.

name: Iron Flesh
description: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.

name: Firestarter
description: Target a model in the spellcaster’s battlegroup. That model’s melee and ranged weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

name: Tides of War
description: While in the spellcaster’s control range, models in its battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. Tides of War lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Fuel for the Flames [5"]

A slammed or thrown model does not suffer an additional damage die for contacting the marker.

Trapdoor markers cannot be placed overlapping a model’s base, obstacle or obstruction terrain.

A friendly Faction non-Leader warrior model/unit that ends its Normal Movement in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker can immediately go into the tunnels. If it does, it is removed from the table and gains Ambush and Tunnel Ambush. When the model/unit is returned to play, do not remove damage from it. (When a model/unit with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, one model can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. If you are the first player, you can place up to two Defenses. If you are the second player, you can place up to three Defenses. If both players play the Defenses Command Card, take turns placing Defenses starting with the second player. A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be placed at the start of the game within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or another Defense terrain feature.

name: Defenses
description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Barrier
description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

name: Cover
description: This terrain feature grants cover.

name: Barrier
description: A Barrier is 4" in length, 1/2" wide, and 3/4" tall.

name: Obstacle
description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

name: Fire Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. A model without Flight entering the area of this terrain feature suffers the Fire continuous effect. If a trooper model without Flight advances through the area of this terrain as part of its unit’s Normal Movement, all models in the unit suffer the fire continuous effect.

name: Illumination
description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

name: Exploding!
description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature also explodes if a model contacts it as a result of slam or throw movement. This terrain feature explodes immediately after a Throw targeting it has been resolved. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

name: Targetable
description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.  This terrain feature does not suffer damage or any other effects from attacks targeting it.

name: Throwable
description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

name: Demolition
description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation. When it does so remove this terrain feature and another Defense within 10" of it from the table.

name: Spike Hazard
description: This terrain feature is a hazard. An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 1" of this terrain feature suffers a POW 10 damage roll. If an enemy warjack without Flight enters this terrain feature, in addition to the POW 10 damage roll, the warjack also suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement System box. Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

name: Duck and Cover!
description: Play this card at any time during the activation of one of your warrior units. Those models gain cover and Resistance: Blast for one round.

name: Hit & Run
description: Play this card any time during the activation of one of your models. That model gains Reposition [3"] this activation. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

name: Sapper
description: Play this card at any time during your turn. Immediately remove a Defense from the table.

name: Old Faithful
description: Play this card during your Control Phase before allocating focus. Remove d3+1 damage from a friendly Cohort model or battle engine in your army.
